content: passlib 1.7.4 last released Oct 2020. No Python 3.13 compatibility. FastAPI community discussion #11773 confirms passlib is unmaintained. Multiple projects (cloud-init, Radicale, pypi/warehouse) tracking passlib abandonment. FastAPI team moved docs to pwdlib. pwdlib is the community-endorsed replacement, though still pre-1.0 (v0.3.0). For projects that cannot migrate immediately, direct argon2-cffi or bcrypt usage is viable.
